scope: 12 initial source accounts; local experimental record, not production schema

subjects.subject: Experiment Softwear
subjects.account: Removed balm from FF cart, then put it back because of the parent recommendation. Crusty lips and wallet complaint are current context/humor; thanks to balm is anticipatory, not a use result.

records.retained: FF meaning unresolved. No completed purchase. Parent recommends Softwear, compares Eadem, reports sensitive skin and backups; those are parent testimony only.

relation.child_claim: Recommendation prompted cart readdition, not experienced benefit

records.uncertainty: Softwear resolves from parent; no formula version or first-use evidence.

subjects.subject: Dr. Idriss lip exfoliator (context-resolved, uncertain)
subjects.account: Likely owns the exfoliator discussed in the parent; cannot stand its feeling and always skips it.

subjects.subject: Dr. Idriss Barrier Baste balm (context-resolved)
subjects.account: Loves the baste balm; no particular benefit asserted.

records.retained: “That one” is not explicit: surrounding baste-balm contrast favors Dr. Idriss exfoliator but does not prove referent. Preserve uncertainty; exclude uncertain avoid-use from definite target counts. No Experiment complaint is established.

subjects.subject: Regimen Lab Wave Serum
subjects.account: Likes Wave and finds it less sticky than Experiment Super Saturated.

subjects.subject: Experiment Super Saturated
subjects.account: Still uses it despite the relative stickiness because the author thinks it has a little more glycerin.

records.retained: Comparison is relative stickiness, not hydration superiority or switching. Parent Level Serum purchase and repurchase intention belong to another actor. Glycerin amounts are not verified formulation facts.

subjects.subject: Experiment Super Saturated
subjects.account: Sister introduced brand through Super Saturated; author loved it and ordered their own. Lightweight, refreshing, fast drying, very hydrating without pores feeling clogged; suitable before makeup.

actions.reason: Own order after sister introduction and favorable experience

subjects.subject: Experiment Buffer Jelly
subjects.account: Bought seeking more nighttime hydration/repair. Initially worried about thick/oily appearance, then woke with glowy, clean skin; tiny amount needed.

subjects.subject: Experiment face wash (exact SKU unresolved)
subjects.account: Immediately bought face wash; reports no more breakouts, makeup comes off with one dollop without separate remover, and hydrated skin.

subjects.subject: Experiment mesh moisturizer (exact SKU unresolved)
subjects.account: Bought immediately at launch; no use outcome given.

subjects.subject: Experiment brand
subjects.account: Loves colorful products on bathroom counter, calls them quirky/delightful; enthusiastic brand and scientist appreciation.

records.retained: Chronology is not proof that one benefit caused all later purchases. Product-page title does not make all clauses Super Saturated claims. Source-scope Refill label does not establish an extra repurchase. Combo/sensitive survey stays context, not a condition on every benefit.

subjects.subject: Experiment Avant Guard
subjects.account: Had paused formerly almost-nightly disposable sheet masks to pursue sustainability; discovering reusable mask through TikTok creator led to immediate checkout. Almost perfect fit except cheeks/nose; easy cleaning. Having mask motivates use of other hydrating/moisturizing products, which author says have helped repair barrier.

actions.reason: Reusable-mask discovery through TikTok in sustainability context

records.retained: Other products are direct referent of barrier-repair statement; do not claim mask independently repairs barrier. Small acid-lime variant in metadata, no shade preference inferred. Sustainability and creator discovery coexist; no isolated causal coefficient.

subjects.subject: Experiment Continuum
subjects.account: Reports neck ingrown-hair control after shaving: shave, moisturize, apply Continuum next morning. Previously ingrowns every time; calls this a game changer and identifies it with desired exfoliation/barrier healing.

actions.condition: Neck; morning after shaving and moisturizing

records.retained: Single self-report of changed neck condition, not objective prevention efficacy. Combo survey not treated as efficacy condition; no purchase event inferred.

Exact body is “undefined...”. Do not convert metadata or product association into customer approval, purchase, or experience. Possible capture/parser artifact; missing meaningful body retained as limitation.

subjects.subject: Experiment Super Saturated
subjects.account: 51-year-old with challenging skin calls it awesome paired with tretinoin and other actives; reports skin left very hydrated.

records.retained: Do not infer irritation prevention, barrier repair, clinical compatibility or that age/skin type caused outcome.

subjects.subject: Experiment Avant Guard
subjects.account: Locks in hydration from Super Saturated; fit is “not the best” on very small head, especially nose, leading to one-star deduction.

actions.condition: Over Super Saturated on very small head

hydration.condition: Avant Guard used over Super Saturated

records.retained: Dry/acne-prone survey is context. No independent Super Saturated hydration event or repurchase counted from this adjunct-use clause.

subjects.subject: Experiment Buffer Jelly
subjects.account: Loves it, reports locking in hydrating products, little goes far, and waking with glowing skin when used at night as final routine step.

actions.condition: Final nighttime step over hydrating products

records.retained: Routine conditional, no measured effect or inferred purchase event.

subjects.subject: Experiment Softwear
subjects.account: Influencer recommended it. Author loved it for months and called it best balm; liked thick texture/sheen despite lip-rubbing resistance. Woke with dead skin needing daily rubbing/brushing; tentatively viewed that as working. Later reports perioral dermatitis, rough tiny bumps and prescribed steroid cream. After recovery, rechallenge flared within 24 hours, worse; author attributes this to Softwear. Three unopened stocked-up tubes left, perceived $70 CAD loss. Still recommends trying at reasonable price while warning sensitive lips; says lips had never been sensitive and prior reaction unprecedented.

actions.reason: During months of liking it; three unopened tubes remain

actions.condition: Try with warning; adverse outcome remains

records.retained: Keep temporal reversal and coexisting qualified recommendation. “Confirmed caused” is author belief supported by their reported rechallenge, not clinical causation. Survey says Combo + Sensitive while body says lips never sensitive; different scopes, do not erase either. No count of purchase occasions or diagnosis verification.

subjects.subject: Regimen Lab Cream 2.0
subjects.account: Recently got cream after overdoing tret, seeking healing moisturizer; favorable experience motivates trying more of line, and author impressed by formulations.

actions.reason: Sought healing moisturizer after heavy tret use

subjects.subject: Regimen Lab cleanser
subjects.account: Picked up to use; nice but pretty small. Greater interest in serums/moisturizers.

subjects.subject: Regimen Lab brand
subjects.account: Author believes products address market gaps in science-based formulations.

records.retained: Post establishes Regimen Lab, not Experiment. Seeking healing is not an explicit healed outcome. Future trial is not acquisition; no market-gap fact established.

findings.question: Does this sample support Super Saturated hydration despite sensory tradeoffs?
findings.statement: Two selected accounts report hydration in different routines; a third uses it despite finding Wave less sticky. Hydration and texture are separate judgments; there is no demonstrated comparative hydration advantage.
findings.limits: Only checked initial sample; routines differ, no cross-person causal link between glycerin and hydration. A07 is unreadable.

findings.question: What accompanies Avant Guard use?
findings.statement: Both selected mask accounts preserve a nose-fit exception alongside favorable use. One ties it to very small head and one also names cheeks. Sustainability/discovery and adjunct-product barrier benefit remain separate.
findings.limits: Mixed attributes, not opposed overall votes. No claim of mask-alone barrier repair.

findings.question: What do the selected Buffer Jelly accounts agree on?
findings.statement: Two accounts report nighttime glow and small amount needed. Only A10 explicitly says it locks in hydration; A04 sought more hydration but reports glow/clean skin.
findings.limits: Source-specific routine and motivation remain visible; no hydration corroboration from desire alone.

findings.question: Can recommendation response and actual Softwear experience be kept distinct?
findings.statement: One reply explicitly credits a recommendation with cart readdition. A different account reports initial enthusiasm, stock-up and later adverse reaction/rechallenge while retaining a qualified recommendation. These are distinct behaviors, not two successful purchases or proof of safe efficacy.
findings.limits: Parent is context only; adverse reaction causal attribution is individual. No prevalence or material-resonance award.

findings.question: Do subjects and ambiguous referents survive coherent accounts?
findings.statement: Regimen Lab acquisitions and intended expansion (A12), Wave comparison (A03), and likely Dr. Idriss avoidance/Baste approval (A02) stay separate from Experiment actions. A02 referent remains uncertain.
findings.limits: Routing observation about records, not a competitor advantage. A06 Continuum report and A04 other-product details retained outside these findings.

common_limits: Exact evidence, actor/time/engagement and context resolve by id in sample.json. Formula versions unknown unless explicit. Scores are unassessed native resonance, never customer headcounts. Accounts are selected source observations, not representative customers; each narrative keeps clauses separately addressable by subject. Raw retained details remain active evidence even when absent from findings.

revision.reason: Preserve qualified severity; one allowed targeted revision.

same_sample_revision.change: Add joint-product hydration attribution; fit and behavior remain solely with Avant Guard.
